notes.title: Get Venetica, a Eurojank RPG about Death's daughter, free for a limited time
notes.notes: In 2009, German studio Deck13—who would go on to make soulslikes Lords of the Fallen and The Surge series—released a third-person RPG in which you play Death's daughter. No, not Susan Sto Helit from Terry Pratchett's Discworld books, though I'd kill for a game about her, but a corset-clad inhabitant of a fantasy version of Venice named Scarlett who fights with a detached scythe blade... Read more.

notes.title: Trading Cards released
notes.notes:
To celebrate this years summer sale on Steam Venetica has been given 70% off. All those who haven't bought it yet should now really consider buying the game right now - who knows when we'll go that low ever again in the near future?

But not only that: We have now officially released the Trading Cards for our beloved game. It has been out now for a while and we thought that it was about time to add this little Steamfeature, finally.

Enjoy the journey!

notes.title: Venetica - Gold Edition
notes.notes:
Did you get Venetica yet? Enjoy Scarlett's adventure now finally on Steam! 

The Gold Edition gives you great bonus material like an Artbook, Soundtrack and never-before seen pitch documents/trailers.

You'll also find that the trading cards, badges and emoticons have found their way into the game!

notes.title: Gold-Edition content
notes.notes:
Dear Venetica fans!

In this announcement we'd like to address the issue of the Gold_Edition content not showing. I am happy to announce that this is fixed. 

As of today, Steam will download the missing contents (approx 1GB data). To find the Gold_Edition content just do as follows:

-> Program Files (x86) -> Steam -> Steam Apps -> Common -> Venetica -> Gold_Edition.

This will give you access to:

- The soundtrack of Venetica
- The Art of Venice (Artbook)
- Never before seen pitching material.

We hope you enjoy it!
